g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-401 Servo auger filler (built in house) · rev B
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: PLAN FROM ABOVE (1:2): SERVO, BRIDGE, GEARMOTOR ON HEAD PLATE 301
Cables up the column, Ø40 pass in 301
1. Spindle cartridge (bench): DIN 471 Ø25 in the lower groove; press the lower 6205 onto the spindle (press the inner ring only) against it.
2. Inner spacer 310, then the upper 6205, then the upper DIN 471 Ø25. Spindle must turn freely with both bearings.
3. Housing 302 flange-up on the bench: drop the cartridge in from the top (Ø52 H7 straight bore) with outer spacer 309 between the outer rings.
4. Seal 25x40x7 into cap 308 (lip up, grease); cap over the spindle onto the housing, 4 x M4 x 16 (H11) 3 N·m: clamps the outer stack.
5. Housing into the head plate pilot Ø50 from above, 4 x M8 x 25 (H3) 20 N·m, Loctite 243.
6. Hub 304: seal 25x40x7 in its bottom pocket (lip down), 2 x 6008 pressed into Ø68 H7 with Loctite 641; press the hub onto the spigot from below, DIN 471 Ø40 under.
7. 30T sprocket plate to the hub flange, 4 x M6 x 16 (H7) 8 N·m. Gearmotor with the 15T on top, shaft down through slot E; chain 52 L; tension 4 mm deflection mid-span; 4 x 1/4-20 (H6).
8. Chain guard 306 from below, 4 x M6 (H12). Bridge 307 on the plate, 4 x M10 x 25 from below (H5). Servo into the Ø70 pilot, 4 x M6 (H4) 8 N·m.
9. Pulleys: 20T on the servo, 40T on the spindle key, M10 end bolt + Ø30 washer (H8) 35 N·m. Belt 450-5M-15: slide the bridge to 4 mm deflection at ~15 N mid-span, then H5 45 N·m.
10. Belt guard 305 to the bridge (2 x M6, H12). Head onto the column cap: 4 x M10 x 30 (H2) 45 N·m. Check runout at the coupling face ≤ 0.05 TIR and the hub TC face ≤ 0.10 TIR.
open-bottom tray: 4 sides up 90°, corners welded + ground; Ø74 for the housing body
2 tabs to the bridge (M6) welded on
tray: 4 sides up 90°, corners welded; 4 tabs 30 x 16 with Ø6.6 at the top edge
(at x -60 / +200, y ±78); Ø86 hole for the hub
